# Legacy residual fixtures

These small v3 (full) and v4 (sampled) dynamic payloads were generated by the
unmodified encoders at commit `43efda8b93767114b7768c94523dc51508f16c6b`, before
the lossless residual fix. The input is the existing `sampleTraceg()` test case,
stored as a JSON string in `legacy-traceg.json` to preserve significant trailing
spaces; `legacy-isa.json` is its static instruction table.

The regression test decodes these fixed bytes with the current reader and
requires the original text byte-for-byte. The fixtures are deliberately not
regenerated by that test, so a writer/reader format change cannot hide a legacy
compatibility regression.
